svg.aria-label: Scheduling-policy effect alone: change in wait versus WPS per paired seed (minutes; below 0 = shorter)
svg.text: Scheduling-policy effect alone: change in wait versus WPS per paired seed (minutes; below 0 = shorter)
Mean of 30 paired synthetic days per scenario; identical patients for every policy and dispatch mode. Whiskers: 95% CI of the paired difference. Each panel has its own scale.
Synthetic simulation (backend/simulation). Hover a bar for its value; numbers are in tables.md.
